summary: Iteration 45: Digital Questionnaire Form & SuperAdmin Leads Tab - All features tested and working. Resources dropdown, 6-step questionnaire form, form submission, SuperAdmin Leads tab with Excel export and status management all functional.

resources_dropdown.details: Resources dropdown in header shows 3 items: Needs Assessment Form, Product Presentation, Download Questionnaire PDF

questionnaire_navigation.details: Clicking 'Needs Assessment Form' navigates to the questionnaire multi-step form

questionnaire_6_steps.details: Form has 6 steps with progress bar: Company Info, Tally Usage, Pain Points, Feature Priority, Decision & Budget, Next Steps

form_navigation_buttons.details: Next/Previous buttons work across all 6 steps

step1_company_info_fields.details: Step 1 shows fields for company name, contact person, designation, phone, email, city, industry radio, employees radio, turnover radio

form_submission.details: Filling minimum fields and submitting shows success message with 'Thank You!' and 'Back to Home' button

product_presentation_pdf.details: FLOWRA_Presentation.pdf exists and returns HTTP 200 (387KB file)

questionnaire_pdf.details: FLOWRA_Customer_Questionnaire.pdf exists and returns HTTP 200 (17KB file)

back_arrow_navigation.details: Back arrow on questionnaire form returns to landing page

footer_links.details: Footer 'Product' section includes 'Needs Assessment' and 'Presentation' links

superadmin_leads_tab.details: SuperAdmin login -> Leads tab shows submitted questionnaire entries (3 submissions visible)

leads_tab_position.details: Leads tab correctly positioned between Referrals and Activity tabs

export_excel_button.details: Export Excel button visible and API returns valid .xlsx file (6KB)

lead_expansion.details: Expanding a lead shows full details (Contact, Designation, Industry, Employees, Turnover, Budget, Timeline, etc.)

status_buttons.details: Status buttons (New, Contacted, Qualified, Closed) visible and update lead status correctly

api_questionnaire_submit.details: POST /api/questionnaire/submit works with valid data - returns success message

api_questionnaires_list.details: GET /api/super-admin/questionnaires returns list of submissions with all fields

critical_code_review_comments: QuestionnaireForm.js has proper data-testid attributes for testing
API endpoints properly secured with super_admin role check
Excel export uses openpyxl with proper styling

test_credentials.note: Login requires captcha_token field - send empty string '' for API, or inject token via localStorage for browser testing

seed_data_creation: Created 3 test questionnaire submissions: TEST_Iteration45_Corp, TEST_UI_Submission_Corp, Test Corp
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 45 verified all new questionnaire features: 1) Resources dropdown in landing page header with 3 links. 2) 6-step questionnaire form with all fields working. 3) Form submission creates entry in database. 4) SuperAdmin Leads tab shows submissions with expand/collapse. 5) Status management (New/Contacted/Qualified/Closed) works. 6) Excel export downloads valid .xlsx file. 7) PDF files (Presentation, Questionnaire) accessible. 8) Footer has Needs Assessment and Presentation links. 9) All APIs tested via curl and working. 10) Browser auth requires token injection via localStorage due to reCAPTCHA.
